annotations.title: Add the realistic texture to a model

description: Paint the realistic texture — from the model's own photos, on every side — on one of the user's models that was made without it (generate_* with realistic_texture: false, or quality fast). The result is a new version of the model with its own model_id; the original stays. Paid: the first call names the price and spends nothing — tell the user, and only after their yes call again with confirm: true. Takes 1–2 minutes: call again with the same model_id to follow it (no new charge). A failed job is refunded.

confirm.description: true = start it at the price the previous answer named. Only after the user agreed.
